2609.11851.title: IndicTriMix: Developing Language Identification Datasets and Models for Tri-Language Code-Mixing
2609.11851.paper_summary: Language identification in code-mixed text, largely observed in social media, is highly essential when users frequently switch between multiple languages within a single utterance. Accurately identifying the languages of code-mixed tokens becomes an urgent necessity. Traditional language identification models, designed for monolingual text, are not well suited for token-level language identification in code-mixed settings. We formulate the task as a sequence labeling problem and fine-tune contextual transformer-based models MuRIL and XLM-RoBERTa best suited for Indian languages. We evaluate these systems on three different data configurations (Hindi, Gujarati, and Bengali) to predict language labels for individual tokens. We release a benchmark for language identification in code-mixed tokens with manually annotated test sets. We propose two approaches of code-mixed generation using parallel sentences of three languages. The trained models demonstrate the effectiveness of contextual embeddings for token-level language identification in multilingual social media text. For reproducibility and to facilitate future research, we publicly release our fine-tuned models.
2609.11851.paper_summary_zh: 語言識別在混合語言文本中，尤其是在社交媒體上，當用戶在單一話語中頻繁切換多種語言時，顯得非常重要。準確識別混合語言標記的語言成為一項迫切的需求。傳統的語言識別模型是為單語文本設計的，並不適合在混合語言環境中進行標記級別的語言識別。我們將這項任務表述為序列標記問題，並微調基於上下文的Transformer模型MuRIL和XLM-RoBERTa，這些模型最適合印度語言。我們在三種不同的數據配置（印地語、古吉拉特語和孟加拉語）上評估這些系統，以預測單個標記的語言標籤。我們釋放了一個針對混合語言標記的語言識別基準，並附上手動標註的測試集。我們提出了兩種使用三種語言的平行句子的混合生成方法。訓練後的模型展示了上下文嵌入在多語言社交媒體文本中進行標記級別語言識別的有效性。為了可重複性並促進未來的研究，我們公開釋放了我們微調過的模型。
